caption: Rao and TCS match gold exactly, but the system opens one LOC span over 'team in Pune' while gold marks only Pune. With C = 2, N = 3 and G = 3 the score is P = R = F1 = 0.67, and the wrong boundary costs twice: one false positive and one false negative.

spec.title: BIO tags vs the system's spans
spec.aria: Nine tokens of the sentence 'Mr Rao of TCS met the team in Pune' lined up under their BIO tags, with a third row showing the system's spans: PER on Rao, ORG on TCS, and a single LOC span running across team, in and Pune instead of Pune alone.
